deployment.dedicated_server: Merge kubejs/** into the stopped server only after the OTA preimage gate passes.
deployment.client: Ship the same KubeJS data file to the final client so its integrated singleplayer server uses the same 544-height dimension type.
deployment.mcmodsync: Keep MCModSync disabled during validation. Restore it only in the final client distribution and do not let it downgrade this overlay or the future transition mod.
deployment.stale_path_removal: Delete only through .ota-delete-list.json after the recorded preimage SHA-256 matches.

protected_zone.terrain_and_biome_slots: Use the already generated and frozen V donor slots through the slot-level OTA tool.
protected_zone.overlay_effect: The height file changes registry bounds only; it does not regenerate, replace, or decorate any chunk.

same_overworld_transition.frozen_mask: All occupied chunks in the final stopped C snapshot UNION the strict 29,305 protected-zone chunks.

bands_in_blocks_from_frozen_mask.write_fence_and_boundary_anchor: inside F and all cross-boundary writes

required_components: Immutable frozen-mask manifest bound to the final stopped C snapshot SHA set
Offline boundary-condition atlas derived from final C heightmaps, fluids and biome cells
544-height composite NoiseBasedChunkGenerator using vanilla 384-height density padded with air and the isolated Tectonic 544-height density
Coordinate-aware biome source and spatial gates for carvers, features, ores and structures
World-generation write fence that rejects any placement into F
Deterministic registry and artifact hashes shared by server and client
same_overworld_transition.safe_fallback: Keep the current Overworld generator vanilla-compatible and use the already namespace-isolated mechanomania_frontier:frontier dimension for complete Tectonic terrain. This fallback is safe but does not satisfy the requested same-Overworld far field.
